prs.author: hi-ogawa
prs.body:
- closes https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11469
- closes https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/11472 supersedes

`taskTitleValueFormatTruncate: 0` is documented to turn off truncation, and it does for `%` placeholders and non-string `$` values, but it was missing for `$` string formatting.

prs.title: fix: resolve node builtins in client environments
prs.author: sheremet-va
prs.body:
Vite resolves node builtins in a client environment to `__vite-browser-external` and drops the module name when `NODE_ENV=production`, so the module runner could not import them. Vitest now resolves them as external builtins in client environments that use the module runner (jsdom, happy-dom, custom environments).

This also makes `vi.mock('os')` without a factory work in those environments.

Fixes #11324

prs.title: feat(browser): highlight selector multiple matches in trace view
prs.author: hi-ogawa
prs.body:
### Description

- part of https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/10156#issuecomment-4340268670

When a trace step's locator matches several elements, the trace view only highlighted the first one, so an ambiguous locator looked like it targeted a single element. Trace snapshots now record every matched element and the viewer highlights all of them. Actions and `expect.element` keep their strict behavior, because only the diagnostic snapshot lookup changes.

```ts
document.body.innerHTML = '<button>One</button><button>Two</button><button>Three</button>'
await page.getByRole('button').mark('Render multiple')
```

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |

The diff is mostly mechanical. The snapshot field changes from `selectorId: number` to `selectorIds: number[]`, the lookup changes from `querySelector` to `querySelectorAll`, and the viewer loops over the ids to draw one overlay each.

prs.title: perf(spy): reset only mocks that were called or reconfigured
prs.author: johan-gorter
prs.body:
### Description

`vi.resetAllMocks()` iterates `REGISTERED_MOCKS`, which holds a `WeakRef` to every mock ever created in the worker, and calls `mockReset()` on each one that is still alive. Its cost therefore grows with the number of live mocks, not with the number of mocks a test actually touched.

With `isolate: false` this becomes the dominant cost of a run. One worker executes many test files, so module-level mocks and every `vi.fn()` that is still reachable keep accumulating. `deref()` also adds each mock to the WeakRef "keep during job" list, so the mocks a test created cannot be collected until the runner yields to the event loop, which rarely happens inside a file. With `mockReset: true` every test then pays for every mock in the worker.

Measured on a large suite (364 files, 6733 tests, `pool: 'forks'`, `isolate: false`, `mockReset: true`, coverage off, 4 workers):

| Vitest                             | wall time | `resetAllMocks()` CPU across workers | max mocks visited per reset |
| ---------------------------------- | --------- | ------------------------------------ | --------------------------- |
| 4.1.11 (`Set` of strong refs)      | 671 s     | 1838 s                               | ~110,000                    |
| 5.0.0 (`WeakRef` registry, #11092) | 189 s     | 465 s                                | ~66,000                     |
| 5.0.0 + this change                | 26 s      | 0.4 s                                | 5 to 50                     |

prs.title: feat: tag cache directories with CACHEDIR.TAG
prs.author: lifeiscontent
prs.body:
Closes #11443

Writes a `CACHEDIR.TAG` ([spec](https://bford.info/cachedir/)) into `cacheDir/vitest` and each fs module cache root, so backup tools and task runners know these files are caches that don't affect results. An existing tag is never overwritten, a failed write is ignored, and each directory is tagged once per process (again after the module cache is cleared).

The new e2e test checks the tag in all three locations, including a project with its own `fsModuleCachePath`, and that an existing tag is left alone.

prs.title: fix(browser): preserve undefined command arguments
prs.author: sheremet-va
prs.body:
Custom commands dropped `undefined` arguments, which shifted the following arguments. A `null` first argument also threw a `TypeError` in the client.

The browser RPC now keeps `undefined` values at any depth, the same as the forks and threads pools.

Fixes #10864
Closes #10865

prs.title: fix(coverage): v8 browser memory leak between test files
prs.author: AriPerkkio
prs.body:
### Description

Resolves https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/11447

As V8 coverage starts profiler, we end up collecting stuff between test files that share same V8 instance (tab). Currently we are not toggling coverage on-off between test files, as that used to break the results. It seems that collecting garbage between coverage toggling fixes this.

This has a performance hit of course, but it's more correct behavior. Running https://github.com/vitest-tests/coverage-large locally on M2 Air:

- `vitest@5.0.3`: 0m36.104s, 0m33.941s
- This PR on `pkg.pr.new`, `2953e5c`: 0m40.244s, 0m41.833s

prs.title: feat(ui): add fit and zoom controls to trace viewer
prs.author: hi-ogawa
prs.body:
### Description

- part of https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/issues/10156 ("Revisit tall viewport size being default")

Trace replay was always shown at 100%, so tall viewports could not be seen at once. This PR adds a zoom popover to the trace viewer header with zoom in/out, fit to pane, and reset. The default stays 100% and the choice persists across reloads.
